title: DAQ-1 bring-up and time-base qualification
measures: frame integrity at 8 kSPS; ADC noise with inputs shorted; sync-pulse clock fit of a second device; encoder loop-back; current-output step
decision: whether every later record can share one clock (DEC-058)
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: none: docs/measurement_rig.md s1.3 lists bring-up steps without an experiment id or criteria

title: R9 frame qualification: plate mode, motion quality, in-situ calibrations
measures: tap-test first mode of the plate stack; head speed stability with the 190 g head; plate matrix residuals; guide stiffness
decision: DEC-058's falsifier (plate mode below 100 Hz); validity of EXP-T01/T02
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: none: DEC-058 names the tap test as its falsifier but no criterion judges it

title: Axially soft wire anchor coupon (the pass's floating anchor)
measures: axial stiffness of the etched 4-beam anchor alone and with its interconnect; assembly tension of the wires
decision: DEC-072 (the reach candidate's fatigue margin rests on 80-120 N/m and <= 5 mN)
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: none: EXP-K21 measures preload on Rev K's diaphragm, not the anchor's stiffness

title: The reach candidate's eight 34 mm C17200 wires at the 1.7 mm stop
measures: lead resistance; fatigue at the 1.7 mm stop with 0.1 A per wire; Goodman factor with measured Kt and tension; Joule heating above the clamps; the coupon's first mode
decision: DEC-072 (keep or drop the 1.5 mm candidate)
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: EXP-K21's criteria fix 26.8 mm wires at Rev K's stop; the reach candidate's length, stop, count and anchor differ

rig: R12 stage + 10 g cell + laser lever
title: Ball-guide drag and tilt against preload, both guides
measures: drag (forward/return half-difference) and carrier tilt at 1-4 N preload under the 35 deg couple, for Rev K's and the reach candidate's guides; marks on a bare Ti flange face
decision: the preload that meets both REQ-RVK-003's tilt and DEC-063's 5 mN drag; the drag entering the duty re-run (DEC-096)
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: EXP-K20 tests Rev K's guide at one preload; the pass predicts 8.07 mN at 4 N, above K20's 5 mN line

title: Five-bar qualification: kinematics, force, stiffness, force cap
measures: endpoint from output encoders against camera truth; continuous force disk; stiffness and lost motion at the holder; force cap and breakaway release
decision: whether the rigid, ideal model of the grounded study describes the hardware (DEC-071); the safety features of DEC-099
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: none: no experiment tests the five-bar

title: Accepted-word replay on paper with a passive pen against spring hands
measures: the 20 accepted 'se' suffixes written by the five-bar: grounded-gate completions without a spring hand; ink after refusal with 200/500 N/m springs; acceleration and jerk
decision: DEC-071 (whole letters need a grounded stage); lift and refusal design
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: none: the grounded results are SIM only (results/improvement/mechanics/grounded_batch.json)

title: Page anchoring through lift and occlusion
measures: absolute-anchor validity flag through lifts, occlusions and glossy strips; absolute error after re-anchoring; lost relative motion
decision: whether accepted writing can resume after an outage (DEC-070, DEC-071)
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: EXP-T04 judges the lift cut-off height and dropouts, not the absolute re-anchoring

title: Contact-channel delay, false contacts and lift timing on R9
measures: delay of the pen-side contact decision against the plate's normal force; false contact/lift rate; command-to-ink-stop time of a voice-coil lift
decision: the delayed contact channel of DEC-070's causal models; the lift a refusal needs (DEC-071)
why_no_existing_experiment_covers_it: none: AC-B05-10 judges axial-force noise, not the contact decision's delay
